articles.summary: TL;DR Teams building AI features want to skip slow A/B tests and decide from offline evals alone. This post looks at when that’s possible while keeping the risk of harming the online metric low. It can work, but only under strong assumptions that are hard to verify and can change over time. Noise is a problem too, because it can hide a strong link between offline and online results. In our example, a naive estimate says the eval explains 24% of the variation in online results, when the true figure is 60%.
articles.title: When Can You Ship on Offline Evals Alone?
